progression.narrative: The performance opens on C4 and dwells most on F in Pishdaramad. The line peaks at Gk4 (388.4 Hz) at 1:19.1. It closes on F3, not the tonic (Eb4 → Eb4 → Eb4 → Dk4 → C4 → F3).
